conservative.requirements: 7 power, must be able to see the open sky or have access to a divination instrument. Effect: You perceive the future as a hazy image of potential events. While this spell is recharging, you may remove a recharge token from it to experience a "flash of the details of which are up to you and the GM. At minimum, grant you {Df} to a skill check. You might, for example, suddenly know which door the bandits will come through, or which dish to avoid at dinner. Special: Regardless of whether or not this spell has recharged, you may only cast it once per session.
conservative.name: Divination
